name: LS ELECTRIC Co., Ltd.
summary: LS ELECTRIC Co., Ltd. provides smart energy solutions in South Korea and internationally. The company offers smart power solutions, including energy management systems, supervisory control and data acquisition systems, distribution management systems, distribution control systems, micro grid systems, and diagnosis solutions; DC, AC, and EC-charger solutions; and LSPS, which performs automatic selection of breakers and determination of protection coordination through fault calculation.
